title: OmGithub
label: Featured
description: A gallery for discovering and playing open-source AI-built browser games, such as Claude of Duty, Claude of Tanks, Starfall and Kart Royale. Each game links to its creator and its source on GitHub. No GitHub repo of its own was found, so no star count is shown.

title: Awesome Decomp Games
description: Our companion list: rated, auto-refreshed index of decompilations, static recompilations, source ports, engine remakes and browser ports. Bring your own game files.

title: Fal Arsenal (Terraria, tModLoader)
description: universal-modder demo: homing missile launcher, tactical nuke, chain-lightning rifle, black-hole gun, three enemies and a Drone Mothership boss. Every sprite generated with fal.

title: San Franciscans civ (Age of Empires II DE)
description: universal-modder demo: a new civilization with a Robotaxi unique unit, delivery drones and a Transamerica Pyramid wonder, rendered from image-to-3D models; includes a reverse-engineered .sld sprite writer.

title: Minecraft inside GTA V
description: universal-modder demo: a Fabric mod and a ScriptHookV + ReShade add-on depth-composite real Minecraft into GTA V story mode; Minecraft mobs fight the police.

title: bailo167/awesome-game-mashups
description: CC0 list of game mods, crossovers and mashups built on decomps, libsm64 and reverse-engineered rewrites. Listed as a reference list: it has under 100 stars, so it is not a ranked entry.
